title: Remote Work Policy
content: Employees are allowed to work remotely up to 3 days a week. Mondays and Fridays are mandatory office days for team synchronization. All remote work requests must be approved by the direct manager at least one week in advance. Ensure you have a stable internet connection and are reachable via Slack during core working hours (10 AM to 4 PM).

title: IT Equipment Request Guidelines
content: To request a new laptop, monitor, or other IT accessories, please submit a request through the IT service portal. Standard laptop replacements occur every 3 years. For urgent issues with current equipment, visit the IT Helpdesk on the 4th floor. Do not purchase equipment directly; all purchases must go through procurement.

title: Annual Leave Policy
content: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Unused leave (up to 5 days) can be carried over to the first quarter of the next year. Sick leaves do not count towards annual leave and require a medical certificate if exceeding 3 consecutive days.

title: Travel Reimbursement Rules
content: For business travel, flights should be booked in economy class. Meals are reimbursed up to $60 per day. All receipts must be scanned and submitted via the Expensify app within 14 days of returning from the trip. Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances.
